fullPassage: As it has done in so many areas, the information-rich online environment has added a new dimension to the area of timeliness. Years ago, learners were restricted to searching for information that was often available only in environments accessible by foot, car, bicycle, or public transportation. It took time to get to information repositories, let alone to find good information. Today, learners can find information instantly through devices that we carry in our pockets, purses, and back-packs. Then, information seeking involved painstakingly finding a few "good" resources among the limited (but vetted) possibilities that were physically accessible. Now, it involves skimming through the limitless (often unvetted) information online that comes and goes at lightning speed. Given many students' tendency to delay — as well as to finish assignments in the least amount of time possible — the dangers of limiting one's information seeking to the online environment are clear.

✅ ② (A) 지역/구역 - (B) 분야: (A) 박물관이 차지하는 물리적 '공간', (B) timeliness라는 추상적 '분야/영역' ← 정답

❌ ③ (A) 지역/구역 - (B) 지역/구역: (B) the area of timeliness는 추상적 '분야'

❌ ④ (A) 분야 - (B) 지역/구역: 둘 다 뒤바뀜
det.tip: area: 구체적=지역/공간, 추상적=분야/영역. the area of ~=~라는 분야

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "an aspect or feature of a situation, problem, or subject"

det.korean: 어떤 상황·문제·주제의 측면이나 특징
det.analysis:
❌ ① repository(저장소): 물건을 보관하는 장소

❌ ② transportation(교통수단): 이동 수단

✅ ③ dimension(차원/측면): 어떤 상황이나 주제의 한 측면·특징 ← 정답

❌ ④ resource(자원): 활용 가능한 자료·수단
det.tip: dimension=차원/측면(a new dimension=새로운 차원/측면)

questions.passage: As it has done in so many areas, the information-rich online environment has added a new dimension to the area of timeliness. Years ago, learners were __________ (restrict) to searching for information that was often available only in environments accessible by foot, car, bicycle, or public transportation.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: restrict → restricted: be동사(were) 뒤 수동태를 만드는 과거분사
det.analysis: restrict(동사, 제한하다) → restricted(과거분사). 'learners were ______'에서 주어 learners는 '제한을 당하는' 대상이므로 수동태 'were restricted(제한되었다)'가 필요. 동사를 과거분사로 변형
det.tip: be + p.p. = 수동태. be restricted to ~ing=~하는 데 제한되다

questions.passage: Now, it involves skimming through the limitless (often unvetted) information online that comes and goes at lightning speed. Given many students' tendency to delay, the dangers of __________ (limit) one's information seeking to the online environment are clear.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: limit → limiting: 전치사 of 뒤에 오는 동명사
det.analysis: limit(동사, 제한하다) → limiting(동명사). 'the dangers of ______'에서 전치사 of 뒤에는 명사/동명사가 와야 함. 뒤에 목적어(one's information seeking)를 취하므로 동명사 limiting이 적절
det.tip: 전치사(of) + 동명사(V-ing). the dangers of limiting=제한하는 것의 위험

questions.passage: As it has done in so many areas, the information-rich online environment has added a new dimension to the area of timeliness. Years ago, learners were restricted to searching for information that was often available only in environments accessible by foot, car, bicycle, or __________. It took time to get to information repositories, let alone to find good information. Today, learners can find information instantly through devices that we carry in our pockets, purses, and back-packs. Then, information seeking involved painstakingly finding a few "good" resources among the limited (but vetted) possibilities that were physically accessible. Now, it involves skimming through the limitless (often unvetted) information online that comes and goes at lightning speed. Given many students' tendency to delay — as well as to finish assignments in the least amount of time possible — the dangers of limiting one's information seeking to the online environment are clear.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 걷기, 자동차, 자전거, 또는 ______으로 접근 가능한 환경
det.analysis:
❌ ① private tutoring(개인 과외): 이동 수단이 아님

❌ ② social media(소셜 미디어): 물리적 이동 수단이 아님

❌ ③ online shopping(온라인 쇼핑): 과거의 물리적 접근과 무관

✅ ④ public transportation(대중교통): 걷기·차·자전거와 병렬되는 또 다른 이동 수단 ← 정답
det.tip: by foot, car, bicycle, or ~ : 모두 물리적 이동 수단의 병렬 → public transportation

det.korean: 생겼다 사라지는 온라인 정보가 ______로 오간다
det.analysis:
❌ ① at a snail's pace(아주 느리게): 온라인 정보의 빠른 속성과 반대

✅ ② at lightning speed(번개같이 빠르게): 무한한 온라인 정보가 매우 빠르게 생겼다 사라짐 ← 정답

❌ ③ under strict control(엄격한 통제 하에): 검증되지 않은(unvetted) 정보라는 흐름과 모순

❌ ④ with great accuracy(매우 정확하게): 'often unvetted(검증 안 된)'과 모순
det.tip: comes and goes at lightning speed=번개같이 빠르게 오간다. 온라인 정보의 휘발적·고속 속성
